correctness.rationale: A characteristic cyclic subgroup gives all automorphisms as affine pairs; all four unit square-roots modulo \(N\) are enumerated; translation congruences exhaustively partition the nonidentity involutions into five explicit sets. The exact commutator criterion partitions them into the stated joins of cliques. A complete proof then derives subgroup maximality and all counts. Independent exact finite brute-force pairwise checks for \(3\le k\le8\) agree with the uniform formula, but no finite sample replaces the proof.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the full elementary abelian two-subgroup geometry of an infinite family of automorphism groups, distinguishing maximal subgroup orders 8 versus 4, counting their multiplicities and every V4 subgroup, and determining the exact involution commuting graph rather than a routine numerical corollary.
